description: This file handles WebPA parameter request processing, including get and set operations, interacting with data models, host interface, and RBUS for parameter management.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for a list of parameter names, handling wildcards and data model interactions.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets parameter values based on provided ParamVal array, invoking SetParamInfo for each.

methods.name: ensureRbusHandle
methods.description: Initializes RBUS handle if not already initialized.

methods.name: getRbusDataTypefromWebPA
methods.description: Maps WAL_DATA_TYPE to RBUS data type.

methods.name: mapRbusDataTypeToWebPA
methods.description: Maps RBUS data type to WDMP data type.

methods.name: rbusGetParamInfo
methods.description: Retrieves parameter info from RBUS, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: GetParamInfo
methods.description: Internal function to get parameter info from data model or RBUS, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: SetParamInfo
methods.description: Internal function to set parameter info, interacting with data model or RBUS.

methods.name: convertFaultCodeToWalStatus
methods.description: Converts fault codes to WAL status codes.

methods.name: isWildCardParam
methods.description: Checks if parameter name ends with '.' indicating wildcard.

methods.name: converttohostIfType
methods.description: Converts string data type to HostIf_ParamType_t enum.
